items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: The interviewer is Monk Rowe. The interviewee addresses him as 'Monk'. There is no mention of Thelonious Monk (the jazz pianist) or any relationship with him.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Clearwater Beach. I’m very pleased to have Dave Frishberg with me—
who is a songwriter extraordinaire and a man with a unique sense of a lyric, I think.
